Metrics.Name: entra.service_activity.network_access_apps
Metrics.Description: Count of Global Secure Access app-policy evaluations in the latest complete 30-minute bucket, by activity (internet/private app policy, allowed/blocked).

Metrics.Name: entra.service_activity.network_access_branches
Metrics.Description: Count of Global Secure Access remote-network branches in the latest complete 30-minute bucket, by connectivity activity (alive, BGP/tunnel connected or disconnected).

Metrics.Name: entra.service_activity.network_access_users
Metrics.Description: Count of Global Secure Access user-policy evaluations in the latest complete 30-minute bucket, by activity (internet/private app policy, allowed/blocked).

Metrics.Name: entra.service_activity.signins
Metrics.Description: Count of tenant sign-ins in the latest complete 30-minute bucket, by activity (MFA success/failure, SAML, Conditional Access outcome). Beta M365 monitoring serviceActivity surface (#368) — measured sign-in experience, distinct from m365.service_health's declared incidents. See the package doc.
